Strange crashes, a persistent blue screen, or a Mac that just will not boot? From a failed Windows 11 upgrade to a macOS Ventura crash, on any brand or model of desktop or laptop.

Common OS Faults

Operating System Problems We Fix.

Most OS trouble comes down to a handful of causes. Here is what we see, and repair, day in and day out.

💥

Blue Screen of Death

A BSOD crashes and restarts Windows without warning, usually from deep system-file corruption or a driver conflict.

🔁

Boot loop

The computer keeps restarting and never reaches the desktop, often from a failed update, a bad install or a corrupted boot sector.

🔒

Login screen freeze

You type your password but never get in, or the field will not respond, normally a corrupted user profile or a startup service conflict.

🍎

Kernel panic (macOS)

The Mac screen goes dark or restarts with an error, usually a memory fault, a bad extension, or hardware not talking to macOS properly.

🗂️

Corrupted system files

Key OS files go missing or unreadable and throw errors at boot or in your apps, often after a failed update or an improper shutdown.

🐌

Slow performance

Minutes to start and sluggish programs, normally bloated startup items, low memory, or years of OS clutter that needs clearing.

♻️

Repeated crashes

Frequent restarts or spontaneous shutdowns, a sign of OS instability from software conflicts or an incomplete install.

⚠️

Failed system updates

A Windows or macOS update freezes or fails midway, leaving the system incomplete, unprotected and misbehaving.

↩️

Rollback errors

Undoing a recent change fails and traps the system in limbo, needing manual work to recover.

🧩

Application conflicts

Apps crash or refuse to launch because of OS-level incompatibilities or permission problems, not the app itself.

🖨️

Sound, printer or display not working

Peripherals drop out when driver files are missing, outdated or corrupted, and come good once the OS driver side is sorted.

🛡️

Security risks

A corrupted or out-of-date OS leaves gaps in your defences and makes the machine an easier target for viruses and spyware.

Every Version

Windows And macOS, New Or Legacy.

We repair current and older systems alike, and match the fix to your exact version.

Windows

  • Windows 11. Install failures, driver mismatches, UI bugs and performance drops.
  • Windows 10. Slow boots, corrupted profiles and broken updates.
  • Windows 8. Start-screen issues, update failures and registry corruption.
  • Windows 7. Legacy support, driver failures and unsupported-software crashes.

macOS

  • Ventura. Inconsistent app behaviour and permission glitches.
  • Monterey. Bluetooth dropouts and audio failures after updates.
  • Big Sur. Boot stalls, system-preference failures and device-detection issues.
  • Catalina & Mojave, 32-bit app crashes, sluggishness and update errors.
Fix My Operating System
Why It Matters

Why Fixing OS Errors Is Worth It.

⚡

Performance

A clean, healthy OS boots faster, multitasks without stalling, and keeps your programs snappy.

🔐

Security

An OS with unpatched holes is a prime target for malware. Keeping it repaired and current keeps your defences up.

📂

Data access

System errors can lock you out of your own files and apps. Fixing them keeps your documents and programs reachable.

🔧

Functionality

When the OS is broken even simple jobs stop working. Repairing it brings back printers, browsers and your everyday tools.

⏳

Longevity

A healthy OS manages the hardware properly, which reduces wear and delays a costly replacement.

😌

Peace of mind

A stable, secure system means you can get on with your work without worrying about a crash or lost data.

Related Services

Sometimes It Runs Deeper.

If a fresh start is the better call, our software install and setup gets your programs back too, and we always take a backup before we touch the OS. Still on Windows 10? We can handle a Windows 11 upgrade. If the trouble turns out to be malware, see virus and spyware removal, and for a general slowdown there is a tune-up.
